text:
Alice M.: Hey team — vendor just replied. They can hold the GPU slot for our canary but only if we push the start window by 3 hours. Can we shift the smoke run?
Ben (infra): +1 on shifting, but need to confirm quota for that window. Our tenant quota renewal kicks in at 01:00 UTC, we might be inside a billing cutover.
Carla P.: @Ben (infra) I pinged procurement. We have a provisional PO but finance needs one small fix. I'll confirm today.
Nikhil R.: If quota is tight during the shift, can we fallback to uk-west as a secondary region? Is the AMI baked there?
Emily S.: uk-west AMI is up-to-date except for the new nvlink driver patch. It should be fine for a quick canary, but perf might be 5-7% worse.
Ben (infra): ok. Two asks: 1) add a quota tag in the TF change so allocations show up in the right billing slice, 2) add a short retry policy in the canary job.
Alice M.: noted. Carla, if procurement confirms extension, we'll update the TF and then toggle the slot. Otherwise we'll spin uk-west and notify vendor.
Carla P.: finance fixed the PO line, vendor confirmed extension until +3h. They asked for a screenshot of the allocation note.
AllocBot: Allocation update: requested slot hold for tenant-redwood until 2026-05-12T18:30:00Z — PENDING vendor-ack.
Ben (infra): here's the small TF snippet to tag the pool, add before apply:```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary" {
  name = "canary-pool"
  tags = { quota_group = "tenant-redwood" }
}
```
Nikhil R.: I'll add uk-west fallback to the canary config: simple region list and an exponential backoff.
Emily S.: also adding a quick perf check so we can flag the 5-7% regression immediately.
Alice M.: plan: Carla will attach the PO screenshot to vendor, Ben will PR TF tags + retry, Nikhil will add fallback, Emily will add perf assertion. We aim to flip the start time +3h.
Carla P.: attaching PO screenshot now -> https://files.redwood/procurement/po-4823.png :thumbsup:
Ben (infra): PR opened: https://gh.redwood/infra/pulls/1287 — includes tag + retry. Requesting @alicem review.
Alice M.: reviewing now. If all green, I'll schedule the canary shift and post final start time. Thanks all. :rocket:
